title: acer cappadocicum subsp. mayrii
intro: Acer cappadocicum subsp. mayrii, commonly known as Mayr's maple, is a subspecies of maple tree that is native to Turkey. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mayr's maple include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help in soothing respiratory issues and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of Acer cappadocicum subsp. mayrii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
